## 验证方式 / Validation

<!-- 写明实际执行的游戏验证、测试或构建命令；未执行的项目请说明原因。List the game checks, tests, or build commands actually run. Explain anything not run. -->

## 影响与风险 / Impact and Risk

<!-- 说明是否影响地图、存档、replace_path、共享资源、兼容性或其他仓库。Note any impact on maps, saves, replace_path, shared assets, compatibility, or other repositories. -->

## 检查项 / Checklist

- [ ] 本次改动只包含一个明确主题，没有顺手修改无关内容。 / This PR stays focused on one clear topic.
- [ ] 已完成与改动相关的测试、构建或游戏验证。 / Relevant tests, builds, or in-game checks have been completed.
- [ ] 需要同步的文档、本地化和资源绑定已经更新。 / Related documentation, localization, and asset bindings are updated.
- [ ] 提交中不包含个人路径、密钥、日志、存档或无关生成文件。 / No personal paths, secrets, logs, saves, or unrelated generated files are included.
